title: Golden Master Webapp Site Config v0.1
description: Non-secret configuration for one target site. Secrets (Basic-Auth / app-login credentials) live in a sibling .env file, never in this file.

id.description: URL-safe unique identifier, matches the sites/<id> directory name.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the UI.

baseUrl.description: Seed URL the crawler starts from.

folder.description: Optional group name for organizing sites/test cases in the UI (e.g. "customer-portal", "admin").

labels.description: Free-form tags for filtering sites/test cases in the UI (e.g. ["smoke", "nightly"]).

ruleSpecDir.description: Path (relative to this site's directory) holding Rule Spec YAML/JSON files.

manualFormsPath.description: Path (relative to this site's directory) to a hand-authored forms.json-shaped file (array of ScannedForm objects, each optionally with a `preSteps` array). When set, this replaces the crawler's live form detection as the source of form definitions fed into semantic inference / pairwise generation / codegen — use this for pages where fields only appear after a wizard-style interaction (e.g. selecting a radio button) that the generic crawler can't discover on its own.

outputDir.description: Path (relative to this site's directory) where crawl/test-case sessions are written.

successCheckpoint.description: url:/selector:/text: prefixed string marking success without needing an error-free page.

login.description: Non-secret application-login hints. Credentials go in .env as LOGIN_USER / LOGIN_PASS.

browser.description: Browser engine, device emulation, and client-certificate settings for crawling/test execution.

device.description: Playwright device descriptor name for viewport/UA emulation (e.g. "iPhone 14", "Pixel 7"). See Playwright's `devices` registry for valid names.

clientCert.description: Non-secret client-certificate paths (relative to this site's directory). The passphrase, if any, goes in .env as SECRET_CLIENT_CERT_PASSPHRASE.

origin.description: Origin the certificate applies to, e.g. "https://example.com".

basicAuth.description: Flags that Basic-Auth is used. Credentials go in .env as BASIC_USER / BASIC_PASS.

variables.description: Standard (non-secret) named values usable as {{NAME}} tokens inside scenario step url/selector/value fields. Secret variables are never stored here — set them via .env as SECRET_<NAME>=value instead.

scenario.description: Reusable browser steps run before crawling/test execution (see core/scenario/siteScenario.js). `login` credentials live in .env.

steps.description: Steps may reference a shared step group via { action: 'useSharedStep', name }, see sites/<id>/shared-steps.json.

dataSource.description: Name of a CSV file under sites/<id>/data/<name>.csv; when set, the scenario runs once per row for data-driven testing, with each row's columns available as {{COLUMN}} variables.

scenarioExpansion.description: Declarative, site-config-driven test-case expansion. Generalizes the idea of 'when this URL and trigger selector are both present, synthesize N extra scenario test cases from templates' without any hardcoded per-site logic in the runner.

urlPattern.description: Regex (string form) matched against the scanned form's URL.

triggerSelector.description: CSS selector that must exist among the scanned form's fields for this expansion to apply.

templates.description: Each template describes one extra generated test case as a set of selector -> value overrides applied on top of the form's normal-value baseline.

overrides.description: selector -> literal value string to assign for this template.
